content.text:
I submitted index 5 (Ag 0.50 / Sb 0.50) as the best composition. At 0.064% EQE it was the highest of the three I could measure, but that is not proof it's the best in the library. The library has 27 compositions and the budget allowed only three EQE measurements, so I sampled the middle, the Ag-rich end and one Sb-rich point.

| Index | Ag : Sb | Known phase at that composition | EQE |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.50 : 0.50 | AgSbO3 | **0.064%** |
| 0 | 0.67 : 0.33 | Ag-rich end of the library | 0.034% |
| 7 | 0.44 : 0.56 | Ag7Sb9O25 | 0.0009% |

- **Uncertainty:** the three points show a peak near 1:1. Compositions between index 0 and index 5 (indices 1–4) were not measured and could be slightly better.
- **Sb-rich side:** only index 7 was measured on this side. It dropped to almost nothing, so I didn't look further there. Indices 8–26 are still untested.
- **XRD:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase labels are what the database lists for those compositions, not what the films actually contain. XRD doesn't count toward the score, so leaving it unused cost nothing directly.
